invariant: s ≤ gas.length ∧ ∀ k, k < s → ¬ ((List.range gas.length).all (fun i => decide ((List.range (i + 1)).foldl (fun t j => t + gas[(k + j) % gas.length]! - cost[(k + j) % gas.length]!) 0 ≥ 0)) = true)
guard: s < gas.length ∧ ¬ ((List.range gas.length).all (fun i => decide ((List.range (i + 1)).foldl (fun t j => t + gas[(s + j) % gas.length]! - cost[(s + j) % gas.length]!) 0 ≥ 0)) = true)
result: if s < gas.length then (s : Int) else -1

lemmas.name: exit8
lemmas.statement: ∀ (gas cost : List Int) (h : canCompleteCircuit_precond gas cost) (s : Nat), (s ≤ gas.length ∧ ∀ k, k < s → ¬ ((List.range gas.length).all (fun i => decide ((List.range (i + 1)).foldl (fun t j => t + gas[(k + j) % gas.length]! - cost[(k + j) % gas.length]!) 0 ≥ 0)) = true)) → ¬ (s < gas.length ∧ ¬ ((List.range gas.length).all (fun i => decide ((List.range (i + 1)).foldl (fun t j => t + gas[(s + j) % gas.length]! - cost[(s + j) % gas.length]!) 0 ≥ 0)) = true)) → canCompleteCircuit_postcond gas cost (if s < gas.length then (s : Int) else -1) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro gas cost h s hinv hg
  obtain ⟨hs, hk⟩ := hinv
  unfold canCompleteCircuit_postcond
  intro valid
  have hv : ∀ k, valid k = ((List.range gas.length).all (fun i => decide ((List.range (i + 1)).foldl (fun t j => t + gas[(k + j) % gas.length]! - cost[(k + j) % gas.length]!) 0 ≥ 0))) := fun k => rfl
  by_cases hlt : s < gas.length
  · have hvs : valid s = true := by
      rw [hv]; by_contra hn; exact hg ⟨hlt, hn⟩
    rw [if_pos hlt]
    refine ⟨by omega, fun hneg => by omega, fun _ => ⟨by simpa using hlt, by simpa using hvs, ?_⟩⟩
    rw [List.all_eq_true]; intro k hk'
    have hk2 := hk k (by simpa using List.mem_range.mp hk')
    simp only [Int.toNat_natCast] at hk'
    have := hk k (List.mem_range.mp hk')
    simpa [hv] using this
  · have hsl : s = gas.length := by omega
    subst hsl
    rw [if_neg hlt]
    refine ⟨by omega, fun _ => ?_, fun hge => by omega⟩
    rw [List.all_eq_true]; intro k hk'
    have := hk k (List.mem_range.mp hk')
    simpa [hv] using this

lemmas.name: step8
lemmas.statement: ∀ (gas cost : List Int) (s : Nat), (s ≤ gas.length ∧ ∀ k, k < s → ¬ ((List.range gas.length).all (fun i => decide ((List.range (i + 1)).foldl (fun t j => t + gas[(k + j) % gas.length]! - cost[(k + j) % gas.length]!) 0 ≥ 0)) = true)) → (s < gas.length ∧ ¬ ((List.range gas.length).all (fun i => decide ((List.range (i + 1)).foldl (fun t j => t + gas[(s + j) % gas.length]! - cost[(s + j) % gas.length]!) 0 ≥ 0)) = true)) → (s + 1 ≤ gas.length ∧ ∀ k, k < s + 1 → ¬ ((List.range gas.length).all (fun i => decide ((List.range (i + 1)).foldl (fun t j => t + gas[(k + j) % gas.length]! - cost[(k + j) % gas.length]!) 0 ≥ 0)) = true))
lemmas.proof:
by intro gas cost s hinv hg
  obtain ⟨hs, hk⟩ := hinv
  obtain ⟨hlt, hn⟩ := hg
  refine ⟨by omega, fun k hk' => ?_⟩
  by_cases he : k = s
  · subst he; exact hn
  · exact hk k (by omega)
